title: Summarize offline experiment scores
description: Read server-computed summaries over all experiment results, grouped by exact immutable scorer version, independently of item pagination. Pass rates divide passing scores by successful results only; errors, skipped, not-applicable, and missing results are separate. Numeric/categorical scores without a passing rule have null pass rates. Repeated trials each contribute an item. Page with next_cursor and unchanged filters.
